text:
Jordan: Heads-up, AcmeCo POC hung during a live demo. UI shows ~8k trial credits but API returned quota_exceeded 429. Demo team stuck.

Priya: Which 429 detail? rate vs credit? any headers from the client?

Jordan: Customer pasted this snippet: 
> {"error":"quota_exceeded","code":429,"reason":"trial_credits_depleted"} 
They say portal still shows credits.

Luis: I just pulled the billing ledger for acct acmeco-prod: last_credit_event set credits=0 at 2026-03-01T09:04Z. Portal cache still shows pre-migration balance.

Alex-SE: tagging @infra-oncall and @billing-bot. For demos we can do quick top-up but want root cause. Also customer worried about token accounting for streaming tokens. Need clear explanation.

infra-oncall: Looking at edge logs for acmeco-prod. Some responses include: 
```
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
x-rate-limit-limit: 180
x-rate-limit-remaining: 0
x-rate-limit-reset: 12
x-account-credits: 0
x-account-tokens-used: 12456
```
This looks like credits=0; rate-limit hit is secondary.

billing-bot: Spend alert triggered for acmeco-prod: usage $1,150, threshold $1,000 at 2026-03-01T09:05:12Z. Account balance: 0 credits.

Priya: Got it. Portal cache invalidation during yesterday's onboarding migration failed for this org. DB is authoritative.

Jordan: Can we temporarily top them up for the rest of the demo? They'll escalate if we don't.

Luis: I can run admin-cli: `redwood admin grant-credits --acct acmeco-prod --amount 10000 --reason "POC demo emergency"` Once someone from finance signs off I'll execute.

finance-bot: Approval required from finance for one-off credit > $500. Approver: @Luis or @Sam-Finance.

Jordan: Sam-Finance is OOO. Luis, can you proceed and we'll reconcile later?

Luis: Proceeding. Executed grant, DB shows credits_remaining=10000. 

billing-bot: Manual credit grant recorded: +10000 credits by Luis at 2026-03-01T09:08:03Z.

infra-oncall: Flushed portal cache for acct acmeco-prod: `POST /internal/cache/invalidate?key=acct:acmeco-prod` Portal now reports 10000 credits.

Alex-SE: Re-ran the customer's curl sample: 
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <demo-key>" \ 
 https://api.redwood.example/v1/stream -d '{"model":"redwood-1","prompt":"test"}'
```
Now returning 200 + streaming. Response header: `x-account-credits: 9995`.

Jordan: Please send a short customer note: explain cache mismatch from migration + we restored demo credits and muted spend alerts for 2 hours.

Luis: Sent DM to customer and muted spend alerts: `POST /alerts/mute?acct=acmeco-prod&duration=2h`. Also created internal ticket BILL-2026-078 to reconcile one-off credits and migration hook.

Priya: Follow-ups: (1) add migration cache invalidation test, (2) add an alert when portal vs billing delta > 500 credits, (3) document streaming token vs credit guidance for SE playbook.

infra-oncall: I'll also temporarily raise soft rate-limit for acmeco-prod 180->720 for next 4 hours to avoid demo flakiness. Will revert automatically.

Jordan: Thanks. Alex-SE please include a short FAQ about how streaming token consumption maps to credits so AcmeCo doesn't get surprised after demo.

Alex-SE: On it. I'll meet with them tomorrow to walk through expected token burn for their demo prompts.

Jordan: Great work team. Keep me posted if any alerts re-fire. :thumbsup:
